THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
5 · Follow the party’s town lead
Change prepared scene
Ask the players

Which lead matters most now: Gundren, Redbrands, the stolen goods, Iarno, or an out-of-town rumor?

Choices

Do not require every location in one session. Follow only the lead the players choose.

If they focus on Gundren, a questioned Redbrand or Iarno’s papers can establish the gang’s role and Cragmaw Castle destination. Qelline can independently point toward Reidoth; Halia can point toward the gang’s goblin. Droop knows only a broad direction, while a captured bugbear can give a more precise castle lead. Reveal only what the party actually uncovers.

If they return to Cragmaw Hideout, Yeemik is still in charge after keeping his bargain. Play the visit as a new consequence of that deal.
